notes.title: New Update 2024
notes.content:
After years of anticipation, Odyssey VR is back with a massive update! Get ready for an enhanced interstellar adventure with improved mechanics, new environments, and deeper immersion than ever before.

🔥 What's New?
✨ Revamped physics – Experience space like never before!
🌠 New asteroid fields – Dodge or destroy, the choice is yours!
🎵 Fresh audio design – More immersive soundscapes and effects!
🛠 Bug fixes & performance improvements – Smoother, faster, better!

Thank you for your patience and support. It’s time to put your helmet back on and continue your journey through the cosmos! 🚀✨

Update your game now and explore the unknown![url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31142121/93f322be21d976d1db424b6ee1de4a6f475893ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31142121/4ad86fba50e312d1ef593350977eec708feba2b5.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 37. Bug fixes, Optimization and new content
notes.content:
Hi!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31142121/9439adb2f957e9299bb6cac0fed678819821fc84.png[/img]

There was a problem when some streamers and players experienced crashes during the Act 1 gameplay. We have fixed the issue and updated the game.

Update includes:

1. Update to crashing
2. Erased the exit game function in act 1.
3. Optimizations for Headsets.
4. VR quick teleport menu is now located in the spaceship wall.
5. Extended the teleportation area in the space ship.
6. Created extra buttons to get out from controlling the ship's movements.
7. Fixed the issue with door animation.
8. Fixed the out-of-scale feeling in the main lobby in VR.
9. Added a second tutorial teleportation zone.
10. Fixed some materials in the main lobby as they were too bright for eyes in VR.
11. Added a tooltip when you press ESC keyboard button when playing the Desktop Experience. 
12. Added a patch note and version number in the menu when you start the game.

Image: Here is a quick reminder that the engine nozzles are located outside of the spaceship. If you are moving, just use your controller to fly around or teleport. You need to find the tool first and it is located neat the moving spaceship part when you are taking a spacewalk after the asteroid hits. When you have the tool, you can fix the engine nozzle that is located in right behind the spaceship. Just click multiple times and you will win the game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31142121/225da61e777c8a916161f1a350a1cf10406a86b1.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 35. Resolution Optimized | Hints added
notes.content:
Hi! Update for Odyssey VR!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31142121/a5528f557b4257846e3a74b594b12259ae0a17cd.png[/img]
We are getting closer to the full launch.
Some of the fixes this time include:
- Shortcut key hints to the start for Desktop
- Optimized graphics and resolution.
- New resolution selector before starting the game window.
- Hints and tips to Odyssey ship's interior.
- Story elements to the game.
- Changed the material to the glass that you can actually see the space!
- New front added to the GUN 1 experience.

We would love to hear how the new resolution box worked? The common practice is to use just full window when starting a game. However, Odyssey VR can be both played in VR and with Desktop, so we were thinking that the resolution selector would be handy. What do you think? Is it easy to start a game in VR or with Desktop?

// Getting closer to the full launch! //

Coming soon:
- New video
- New soundtrack DLC

notes.title: Update 34. New desktop movement | Multiplayer Fixed
notes.content:
Hello! 

There are some improvements to the gameplay. 

1. The multiplayer disconnect issue fixed when the two players were shooting the asteroids in the act 1.
2. Door collider added and tested in VR. Collider fix in VR.
3. Desktop gameplay: Mouse sensitivity lowered, movement speed lowered.

COMING SOON:
Full Odyssey VR Release, new video to the marketing page.

notes.title: Update 33. New Animations | Knuckles
notes.content:
Hello! 

There are some improvements to the gameplay. Also, we received a free set of VALVE Knuckles.
1. No unity splash screen.
2. New door animations to the main lobby.
3. Starting the game with VR device is now smoother, since there is no additional screen when you click on play on Steam.
4. Tested with Valve Knuckles and the game is working. However, the device models are not showing. However, you can complate the game using the Knuckles! :)

Best,
J

notes.title: Odyssey - Update 2.1 VR and Performance
notes.content:
Hi! There have been new modifications to the VR gameplay and overall experience (Including Multiplayer).

- General Bug fixes to model placements and usability
- More confortable teleportation when Using HTC VIVE or Mixed Reality
- Windown Mixed Reality Support
- New effects added
- The player can now wait up to 30 seconds when they have been clicked on New Game button.
- Walking guides to guide the player to the right locations.

Note to VR Players! Please note that when you are playing with, for example, laptop and Mixed Reality Device: 

*** Minimize your Window this it is not going to show up on a computer screen and you can see the quick performance change from your VR Headset. ***

Tested with: Acer Windows Mixed Reality Headser, HTC VIVE, Desktop.

Coming very soon: Updates to the starting of the game and the story. New content coming soon!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31142121/b03aba350d80166c689171f36df5e890daee4f64.png[/img]
